notes.page_content: The author continues the class-count argument: the opening identifies the classes of Pi_I using classes of Pi_J and the two written intersections. He writes that the two classes are nonempty, citing a neighbourhood of corrected E_i and the two barred nonemptiness expressions. He then writes the count (n-1)+2=n+1=card I+1 and describes this as completing the induction on the number of classes. The underlined Lemme states a representation by X minus an indexed union of Sigma_alpha^+ cup E_alpha, with the added hatted-Sigma label over that group; the body gives the written membership and pairwise-disjointness clauses. The final parentheses expressly relate the hatted and ordinary pairwise-intersection expressions by a double implication. These are attributed manuscript assertions, not results checked by this reading.
notes.authors_own_uncertainty: No explicit question mark or verbal uncertainty phrase was found. The exact raised words non vide are cancelled. All unsure alternatives in reading.tex are editorial ink uncertainties.
notes.title_date_page_counts: One sheet. Underlined heading Lemme; no date and no separate manuscript page-number label. The lower-left archive numeral 19 is recorded only in the required comment, with undetermined hand. H page 19 maps to our scan 20.
notes.mathematics_led_reading_decisions: No formula was repaired from expected mathematics. Long upper rules were inspected locally. The first paired Sigma index, the cancelled Sigma index, the union-index state and the reworked membership retain explicit alternatives. No calculation, proof check, geometric-extrema check or pixel comparison was performed.
notes.source_administration: No cotefile command is added on scan 20. The H editorial note about adjacent pages was read as apparatus; those other pages were not opened or collated. H emphasis and our single underline agree on the word Lemme. Ordinary line-wrap/display placement and the approximate margin rotation do not create correction counts.
notes.source_silent_choices: The complete source selects achève with a grave, par in full, récurrence with an acute, où with a grave, both occurrences of nb without a following point, and lowercase card. It retains the upper-display plus/minus signs, the first-intersection comma, the comma after voisinage de E_i, comma/period endpoints of the nonemptiness pair, both final hats, and the final parenthesis and period. The latter two Pi superscripts print circle while their zero alternatives remain explicit in the report. The tiny final component of la is represented through that word once, not as a second free point. The source contains no extra detached-mark path beyond the six declared guide/operator/brace/cancellation paths.
